QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the memory-buffer allocator installs its own calloc/free via mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free, and that MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY is needed for the runtime option. It never says the buffer allocator itself requires MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY, or that enabling the buffer allocator alone is not enough.
